description: Autonomous agents may not reassign VLAN membership across many ports at once — interface ranges, port-access role rebinds, or scripted loops. Single-port moves stay allowed; broadcast-scope changes require human approval to prevent an agent from splitting a floor or a data center off the network.
message: Blocked: this action would reassign VLAN membership across multiple ports at once. Broadcast-scope VLAN moves must be approved by a human — agents can propose the plan and per-port sequence but cannot commit the bulk change.
guidance: Break the change into per-port steps, write the sequenced plan to remediation.log with affected ports and blast radius, and open a change ticket. An authorized operator can approve the full bulk change in the Conduct console.
